name: Sirenbean
description: A tiny emerald-haired mermaid nestled in a warm coffee cup. Her little star crown glows whenever a friend arrives.

name: Foamfin
description: One graceful green tail carries her through curls of coffee steam. She offers her favorite coffee bean to anyone who needs a little kindness.

name: Cremasiren
description: Her foamy fins unfurl into sweeping waves as a golden star crown awakens. Her song turns an ordinary coffee break into a moment of wonder.

name: Emerald Siren
description: An emerald guardian with one flowing emerald tail and a halo of floating coffee beans. Her warm magic makes the café feel like a safe harbor.

name: Sovereign Siren
description: The mermaid queen's luminous star crown shines over a sea of cream and emerald. Her magnificent twin tails carry the wishes of every friend she has made.
